scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 3 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 146). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 3'.

NAMUNA XAT (a - Anne Brown): 'Dear Sir/Madam, I lost my suitcase on flight DLT456 from New York to Heathrow on 5th August. It is a large rectangular blue suitcase. It is made of plastic and it has four wheels and a blue plastic handle. It also has one side pocket. Inside, there are some clothes, shoes and a camera. It has also got some documents in it. If by any chance someone has handed it in to the lost property office, please contact me on (0171) 6274731 after 6 pm any day. Yours faithfully, Anne Brown'

TO'RT KARTA (yo'qolgan buyumlar):
a) Name: Anne Brown. Telephone: (0171) 6274731 (after 6 pm any day). Item Lost: suitcase. Place/Date: flight DLT456, New York - Heathrow (5th August). Description: rectangular, plastic, blue plastic handle, side pocket. Contents: clothes, shoes, documents, camera. [RASM: ko'k g'ildirakli jomadon]
b) Name: Martha Wilson. Telephone: 555-3617 (9 am-5 pm, Monday-Friday). Item Lost: handbag. Place/Date: flight TWA 106, Madrid - Los Angeles (26th August). Description: small, rectangular, black, leather, gold clasp. Contents: brown purse, credit cards, keys, driving licence, small amount of cash. [RASM: qora teri sumka]
c) Name: Ian Baker. Telephone: (0131) 9407321 (any time). Item Lost: briefcase. Place/Date: 9.50 train, London - Edinburgh (1st March). Description: rectangular, brown, leather, dark brown, plastic handle. Contents: business papers, mobile phone. [RASM: jigarrang portfel]
d) Name: Tim Jones. Telephone: (0597) 261436 (after 5 pm, Monday to Friday). Item Lost: travel bag. Place/Date: flight BA 1432, Munich - Gatwick (14th November). Description: rectangular, green, yellow, red and blue, nylon, two side pockets with black zips, black nylon shoulder strap, black and blue handle. Contents: video camera in a black leather case, wallet, clothes, souvenirs. [RASM: rangli sport sumkasi]

Pastda: 'Dear Sir/Madam,' va 10 ta bo'sh qator.

⚠ Bu 3-unitdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon - yo'qolgan buyum haqida rasmiy xat.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 3: Lost property letters

exercises.instructionEn: Read the model letter (card a - Anne Brown). Dear Sir/Madam, I lost my suitcase on flight DLT456 from New York to Heathrow on 5th August. It is a large rectangular blue suitcase. It is made of plastic and it has four wheels and a blue plastic handle. It also has one side pocket. Inside, there are some clothes, shoes and a camera. It has also got some documents in it. If by any chance someone has handed it in to the lost property office, please contact me on (0171) 6274731 after 6 pm any day. Yours faithfully, Anne Brown
exercises.instructionUz: Namuna xatni o'qing (a karta - Anne Brown). Hurmatli janob/xonim, Men 5-avgust kuni Nyu-Yorkdan Heathrowga DLT456 reysida jomadonimni yo'qotdim. Bu katta to'rtburchak ko'k jomadon. U plastikdan yasalgan, to'rtta g'ildiragi va ko'k plastik dastasi bor. Bitta yon cho'ntagi ham bor. Ichida kiyimlar, poyabzal va kamera bor. Ba'zi hujjatlar ham bor. Agar kimdir uni yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, har kuni soat 18:00 dan keyin (0171) 6274731 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling. Hurmat bilan, Anne Brown
exercises.explanationUz:
YO'QOLGAN BUYUM HAQIDA RASMIY XAT
- TUZILIShI:

  1 'Dear Sir/Madam,' - kimga
    yozayotganingizni bilmasangiz
  2 NIMA, QAYERDA, QAChON yo'qoldi:
    'I lost my suitcase on flight
     DLT456 ... on 5th August.'
  3 TAVSIF (sifatlar tartibi!):
    'a large rectangular blue
     suitcase' - o'lcham, shakl,
     rang
    'It is made of plastic' -
     material
    'it has four wheels and a blue
     plastic handle' - qismlar
  4 IChIDA NIMA BOR:
    'Inside, there are some clothes,
     shoes and a camera.'
  5 ILTIMOS + ALOQA:
    'If by any chance someone has
     handed it in ..., please
     contact me on ...'
  6 'Yours faithfully,' - 'Dear
    Sir/Madam' bilan juft (rasmiy)


⚠ 'YOURS FAITHFULLY' va 'YOURS
SINCERELY':

  Dear Sir/Madam → Yours faithfully
  Dear Mr Brown → Yours sincerely


⚠ 'IF BY ANY CHANCE':

  = agar tasodifan.


⚠ 'TO HAND IN':

  = topshirmoq.


⚠ 'LOST PROPERTY OFFICE':

  = yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limi.


⚠ 'TO CONTACT SOMEBODY ON + RAQAM':

  = ... raqamiga bog'lanmoq.


⚠ 'A HANDLE':

  = dasta.


⚠ 'A SIDE POCKET':

  = yon cho'ntak.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the lost items to their owners. b) Martha Wilson - handbag (flight TWA 106, Madrid - Los Angeles, 26th August): small, rectangular, black, leather, gold clasp; brown purse, credit cards, keys, driving licence, cash. c) Ian Baker - briefcase (9.50 train, London - Edinburgh, 1st March): rectangular, brown, leather, plastic handle; business papers, mobile phone. d) Tim Jones - travel bag (flight BA 1432, Munich - Gatwick, 14th November): rectangular, green/yellow/red/blue, nylon, two side pockets, shoulder strap; video camera, wallet, clothes, souvenirs.
exercises.instructionUz: Yo'qolgan buyumlarni egalariga moslang. b) Martha Wilson - qo'l sumkasi. c) Ian Baker - portfel. d) Tim Jones - sayohat sumkasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT KARTA:

  a) Anne Brown - SUITCASE
     (jomadon) - namuna xat
  b) Martha Wilson - HANDBAG (qo'l
     sumkasi): kichik, to'rtburchak,
     qora, teri, oltin tugma;
     ichida: jigarrang hamyon,
     kredit kartalar, kalitlar,
     haydovchilik guvohnomasi, oz
     naqd pul
  c) Ian Baker - BRIEFCASE
     (portfel): to'rtburchak,
     jigarrang, teri, plastik dasta;
     ichida: ish qog'ozlari, mobil
     telefon
  d) Tim Jones - TRAVEL BAG
     (sayohat sumkasi): to'rtburchak,
     yashil-sariq-qizil-ko'k, neylon,
     qora zamokli ikki yon cho'ntak,
     qora neylon yelka tasmasi;
     ichida: qora teri g'ilofda
     videokamera, hamyon, kiyimlar,
     suvenirlar


⚠ 'A CLASP':

  = tugma, qisqich (sumka).


⚠ 'A PURSE':

  = hamyon (ayollar).
  ⚠ 'a wallet' = hamyon (erkaklar).


⚠ 'A ZIP':

  = zamok (molniya).


⚠ 'A SHOULDER STRAP':

  = yelka tasmasi.


⚠ 'A CASE':

  = g'ilof.


⚠ 'SOUVENIRS':

  = suvenirlar, esdaliklar.

modelAnswers:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I lost my briefcase on the 9.50 train from London to Edinburgh on 1st March.

It is a rectangular brown leather briefcase. It has a dark brown plastic handle.

Inside, there are some business papers and a mobile phone.

If by any chance someone has handed it in to the lost property office, please contact me on (0131) 9407321 at any time.

Yours faithfully,
Ian Baker

Dear Sir/Madam,

I lost my travel bag on flight BA 1432 from Munich to Gatwick on 14th November.

It is a rectangular green, yellow, red and blue nylon bag. It has two side pockets with black zips, a black nylon shoulder strap and a black and blue handle.

Inside, there is a video camera in a black leather case, a wallet, some clothes and some souvenirs.

If by any chance someone has handed it in to the lost property office, please contact me on (0597) 261436 after 5 pm, Monday to Friday.

Yours faithfully,
Tim Jones
modelAnswersUz:
Hurmatli janob/xonim,

Men 1-mart kuni Londondan Edinburgga 9:50 poyezdida portfelimni yo'qotdim.

Bu to'rtburchak jigarrang teri portfel. Uning to'q jigarrang plastik dastasi bor.

Ichida ish qog'ozlari va mobil telefon bor.

Agar kimdir uni yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, istalgan vaqtda (0131) 9407321 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

Hurmat bilan,
Ian Baker

Hurmatli janob/xonim,

Men 14-noyabr kuni Myunxendan Gatwickga BA 1432 reysida sayohat sumkamni yo'qotdim.

Bu to'rtburchak yashil, sariq, qizil va ko'k neylon sumka. Uning qora zamokli ikkita yon cho'ntagi, qora neylon yelka tasmasi va qora-ko'k dastasi bor.

Ichida qora teri g'ilofdagi videokamera, hamyon, kiyimlar va suvenirlar bor.

Agar kimdir uni yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, dushanbadan jumagacha soat 17:00 dan keyin (0597) 261436 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

Hurmat bilan,
Tim Jones
